commenti.body: It's definitely not a prequel to Nolan's series. Harvey Dent is in the courtroom and is caught in the blast, which conflicts with his origin story in The Dark Knight. I don't think that the guy who kills Arthur at the end is _the_ Joker. I think the idea is that the ideology of Joker cannot be put back into the bottle now that Arthur's inspired so many people, despite it ultimately being a toxic fantasy. I don't think this universe ties into any other existing Batman canon and I hope it never gets a follow up. This is a film that is obsessed with its own status as a sequel, and with the effect that the first film had on the public consciousness. To make a bona fide Hollywood franchise of it would feel like it defeats the point of this one
